backend_observations.result: Bn/Ctx/Mont/Rsa acquire non-null native owners immediately; partial failure unwinds through Drop. RSA_get0_key pointers are borrowed only while Rc<Rsa> remains alive; no raw pointer ownership duplication or unsafe Send/Sync found. SecretBytes clears its live initialized bytes before Vec deallocation.
backend_observations.limits: Rust allocation aborts and native allocator failures are not all recoverable. No proof about compiler/register copies or crash dumps.

backend_observations.result: Pinned AWS-LC BN_clear_free aliases BN_free; BN_CTX_free frees pooled BIGNUMs. Default OPENSSL_free cleanses allocation before free, so BN_CTX use is not an obvious uncleaned-heap path.
backend_observations.limits: Custom allocator hooks bypass default cleanse; effective release allocator and stack-temporary cleanup are not established by this static review.

backend_observations.result: DER capped at800; SPKI must be fully consumed and exact rsaEncryption+NULL; PKCS1 decoder independently enforces full consumption. n/e must exist, width256..512, exponent3/65537, modulus odd. Exact incoming DER preserved. No private-key API is embedded.
backend_observations.limits: Legacy width contract admits2041..4096 actual bits. This intentionally retains legacy admission; it is not a new minimum2048-bit policy or proof that arbitrary issuer modulus is product of two large primes.

backend_observations.result: EVP hashes input before native PSS; same hash used for MGF1. Blind-token emission uses SHA256/salt0. Final verification recovers salt(-2), intentionally preserving legacy signature acceptance; retained auto_salt and RFC/legacy vectors cover this. Native encoder uses actual modulus bits, including2049-bit zero-leading representative; does not duplicate legacy rounded-bit bug.
backend_observations.limits: No new vector execution, malformed-input fuzzing or exhaustive PSS parser corpus was performed.

backend_observations.result: Factor sampled within[1,n); inverse and encoded-message invertibility use BN_mod_inverse_blinded. No secret BN_gcd/nonblinded inverse used. BN_mod_exp_mont uses secret base/public exponent under the pinned header contract. Montgomery multiplications receive reduced values; PSS encoding lies below n. Fixed-width BN_bin2bn input retains public byte-derived width, and export uses BN_bn2bin_padded.
backend_observations.limits: BN_mod_inverse_blinded can report noninvertible if its own random mask is noninvertible; propagated error is fail-closed. Source inspection is not timing/side-channel qualification.

backend_observations.result: Consuming finalize enforces exact width and representative<n, unblinds, verifies against retained original message/key, releases signature only after success. Invalid reply consumes and cleans pending state; API cannot import, clone or serialize inverse state.

Native handles are Rc-based !Send/!Sync and finish within synchronous begin/finalize. OwnedPending contains owned bytes only, has no Debug/Clone/Serialize, and private inverse export is fixed-width. Finalize compares mathematical n/e while caller authenticates exact response DER. Cancellation drops inverse/message buffers; no mutex or shared mutable native cache crosses await.
backend_observations.limits: Caller token is Copy and credential DTOs intentionally serializable; all caller copies/persisted credentials are not erased. Process abort does not run Rust destructors.

backend_observations.result: FFI statuses are checked; failed parser/BN/hash/PSS work returns an error before publication. Allocation checks from prototype are removed only under cfg(test); production helper was already no-op.
backend_observations.limits: AWS-LC RAND insufficient entropy calls abort; returned RandomGeneration tests only cover returned failure cleanup. Exact packaged containment/recovery remains unqualified by this review.

findings.status: confirmed-by-static-counterexample; inherited, not introduced by RSA migration
findings.title: Expired nonzero Plus expiry deletes valid Free connection-token cache
findings.cause: is_plus compares expiry to now, but cache invalidation checks expiry > 0 instead of the computed active subscription status. An expired positive timestamp and cached Free token therefore look like a gained Plus subscription on every refresh.
findings.impact: Deletes current/next valid Free cache before broker subkey/signing RPCs. If refresh subsequently fails, callers lose a usable cache fallback and may wait/fail until broker recovery. Actual broker behavior returning expired Some(timestamp), and a live user-visible incident, were not exercised.

counterexample.execution: Boolean counterexample to source condition; no Rust/live account execution

findings.recommended_next_action: Separate source-owned repair using computed is_plus for level transition; deterministic tests must cover expired nonzero expiry with cached Free and failing broker, preserving valid cache. Keep migration and inherited-fix provenance distinct.

reviewer_independent_confirmation.confirmation: Arithmetic/source-control-flow proof only. Both current/next db_remove precede subkey/signing RPC; no live broker execution or incident attribution.
